_comment: Measured silence, as [start, end] pairs in seconds. Optional: speech-cut infers
an approximation from word gaps when you leave this out.
It is worth measuring, because word end times lie. Compare 'line.' in the
transcript (written as ending at 9.10) with the silence below starting at 4.00:
the speaker actually stopped at 4.0 and the recogniser stretched the word over
the pause. Only the measured map can see that.
Any tool will do. With ffmpeg:
then collect the silence_start / silence_end pairs it prints.
